about.notes: Maintain Refresh on yourself. RDM always retains responsibility for self Refresh. Other jobs can set self_refresh.allow_with_rdm to true to retain responsibility when an RDM is in the party. Uses refresh_cycle spell and MP settings.

precondition: me.main_job == 'RDM' or vars.self_refresh.allow_with_rdm or not partyHasJob('RDM')
